EMI calculator

Monthly EMI ₹21,696

How it is calculated

EMI = P × r × (1 + r)ⁿ ÷ ((1 + r)ⁿ − 1)

P = loan amount, r = monthly rate, n = number of instalments.

Assumptions

  • The interest rate stays the same for the whole tenure.
  • Processing fees & insurance are not included.
